pages.text: Notice 14/2026: The last date to pay the Semester 5 examination fee without late fine is 20 November. A late fine of Rs. 200 per day applies thereafter, up to 25 November. Notice 15/2026: The Annual Tech Fest will be held on 28 and 29 November; classes are suspended on 28 November.

Notice 16/2026: The library will remain open until 10:00 PM from 25 November to 12 December for exam preparation. Notice 17/2026: Students must update their mobile number and email in the ERP profile by 30 November to receive hall ticket alerts.
